links.outcome: LLM management recommendations versus experienced surgeon decisions across three models (accuracy, precision, recall)
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o accuracy 98.28%, recall 91.74%, precision 58.48%; DeepSeek-V3 accuracy 63.79%; Gemini 1.5 accuracy 18.97%, showing wide variation between candidate models.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o demonstrated the highest accuracy (98.28%) and recall (91.74%), effectively identifying most correct interventions but occasionally proposing extraneous options (precision 58.48%).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 1.5) on retrospective clinical vignettes of hand fractures without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
